profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
To be as a software engineer, I will make best use of my computer programming skills, virtual reality techniques, and knowledge representation capability.

Specialties: 1. Programming : C++, C#, Java, MFC,  OpenGL and Python
2. CAD/CAE : Solidworks, Pro/Engineer and CATIA
3. Simulation and Modeling : graphics library, and CAD APIs
4. Knowledge Representation: Ontology with Jena, OWL(Ontology Web Language) and Protégé

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the software development for the Virtual Reality HMD (Head Mounted Displays) SDKs and Apps development team at Intel Sports

positions.title: Senior Research Scientist
positions.description: Do researches on latest VR(virtual reality) technologies and algorithms and try to adapt them into our VR applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Implement and execute cutting-edge solutions in virtual reality, CAD, Knowledge representation, and cloud based application

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
1. Develop an application to import existing CAD drawings and information into Solidworks Enterprise PDM system.
2. Texture, render and animate the Boeing airplane assembly process using 3D Studio Max

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Develop an application for virtual assembly using NVidia Scene Graph (NVSG)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
1. Virtual Reality related researches sponsored  by VATC (Virtual Assembly Technology Consortium) 
2. Virtual Assembly Design Environment
3. Ergonomic Analysis
    - Ontology-based research sponsored by NSF (National Science Foundation)
    - Engineering knowledge modeling of CAD and CAE using ontology
3. Ontology-based semantic mapping between engineering applications (CAD/CAE) : Strategies and Comparisons

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop applications and communication interfaces for ATM (Auto Teller Machine) using C/C++, MFC, and database.

publications.title: ITrain: Ontology-Based Integration of Information and Methods in Computer-Based Training (CBT) and Immersive Training(IMT) for Assembly Simulation
